transformByKind.log1p: ln(1 + x) of the 7-day mean (amounts and counts)
transformByKind.log: ln(x) of the 7-day mean (ratios such as the take rate)

method.description: Five candidate models on the transformed 7-day mean; rolling-origin backtest; model by lowest error at the longest scored horizon; empirical bands widened with the square root of the horizon beyond it; block-bootstrap simulation of one-step residuals.

intents_tx.label: F1 Intents transactions per day
intents_tx.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

tail_tx.label: F2 long-tail organic transactions per day
tail_tx.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

tail_signers.label: F3 long-tail signers per day
tail_signers.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

intents_usd.label: F4 Intents settled volume per day
intents_usd.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

stable_share.label: F5 stable-to-stable share of settled volume
stable_share.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

no_near_share.label: F6 share of settled volume touching no NEAR-chain asset
no_near_share.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

near_token_share.label: F7 share of settled volume with a NEAR-token leg
near_token_share.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

usd_per_tail_signer.label: F8 settled volume per long-tail signer per day
usd_per_tail_signer.chosenReason: lowest mean absolute error at 90 days over 10 origins (ties go to the simpler model)

intents_usd_12m.note: Sum of the daily model levels (7-day-mean scale) over the next 365 days; days missing from the history are not filled.

bandSum80.note: Sum of the eighty percent band path of the thirty-day average over the next 365 days: treats the whole year as one perfectly correlated band, so it is narrower than the simulated range.

lastClose.note: NEAR price is held fixed at the last close; it is not a price forecast.

toll_split.unit: cents per 100 USD settled (one basis point is one cent per 100 USD)
